svg.title: WebSocket
svg.desc: A: the client sends TCP, TLS, WebSocket and OpenVPN to a tls-server listener that serves the WebSocket itself; the status shows outer=direct. B: a reverse proxy or CDN ends the TLS on port 443 and passes the WebSocket at /vpn as plain HTTP to a tcp-server listener on 127.0.0.1:8443; the status shows outer=terminated. On the stream: an HTTP upgrade request, a 101 reply, then binary frames with one record each; the client masks its frames, the server does not.
svg.text: one TLS connection from the client to the server
PACKET STREAM INSIDE THE TLS TRANSPORT
Host is the SNI name if set, else the host name of the remote. Server does not ping.
